The commit, archive, LICENSE and manifest resolve under the new owner; the v0.4.0 tag does not exist on either (gh api releases/tags and git/ref/tags both 404). The manifest is immutable, so this page reports the drift instead of editing it; a new Release with corrected locators is the gls route.

facts.claim: Foundry 0.4.0 promotes the first cross-agency value matrix from the recovered 9,636-repository evidence universe, with twenty scored applications, twelve evidence-qualified God Sources and zero outcome-proven claims.
Thirty Python files compiled, three campaign tests passed, all matrix formula and God Source evidence gates passed, and the publication scan passed.
Twenty repository-by-use-case-by-route entries record value, feasibility, priority, evidence maturity, authority groups, agent operations and falsifiable next gates.
